brief:
The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (Ocha) reported that Israeli authorities have failed to act on requests to protect Palestinian olive farmers and ensure safe access to their groves, according to Middle East Eye.

The organization had previously called on Israeli officials to implement measures safeguarding farmers during the harvest season, when security tensions and settler violence have historically disrupted agricultural work in Palestinian territories.
